env_files.role: Final campaign copy, delivery context, creative freeze, asset-resolution rules, and exclusions
Brand identity, palette, logo treatment, hero crop, hierarchy, contrast, and legacy boundaries
Placement profiles and revision history; active profile must be resolved at creative freeze
Asset index plus approval history, usage matrix, rights, and version-control records
Opaque-named approved, expired, future, wrong-market, wrong-placement, legacy, and reference visual assets
Activation and session packages with high-similarity alternatives and latest-status-at-freeze histories

source_policy.web_usage_note: Closed-env case. Use only task.md and env/.

difficulty_notes: All asset filenames remain opaque and carry no campaign or version hint.
The active platform profile, activation package, session package, and four asset roles must be resolved independently at the creative freeze.
Near-identical pre-freeze superseded, post-freeze approved, wrong-market, wrong-venue, wrong-placement, and out-of-window records are present.
Activation and session package fields override conflicting base-brief fields, so copying the brief alone produces an internally inconsistent Story.
Grounded VQA checks exact factual package contents, asset identities, consistency, and exclusions; it does not award points for general visual attractiveness.
